{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check the revenue column: is it really text?
print("First 5 values of revenue:")
print(df['revenue'].head())

# Check for thousands separators
print("\nAre there commas in revenue?", df['revenue'].str.contains(',', regex=False).any())

# Check for the special QA orders
print("\nNumber of rows with revenue = 999999.99:", (df['revenue'] == '999999.99').sum())"}
